A foundation service must not loop over its service model type.

Back to STXF rulesRead The Standard source

What The Standard says

A foundation service must not loop over its service model type. The analyser reports this as a warning at the declaration or statement that needs attention.

Why it matters

This rule belongs to the Foundation services family. Following it keeps responsibilities and intent visible to readers, tooling and future maintainers.

Bad code example

// Violates STXF001: A foundation service must not loop over its service model type.
foreach (Student student in students) broker.InsertStudent(student);

Good code example

// Follows STXF001
broker.InsertStudents(students);
